source: Entity type at +0x212 paired with the model asset id at +0xE8, read from gpudump_walk_mos and gpudump_walk_jabba.
method: The per-type table at 0x020F03A0 carries only a class byte - 0x1E for both turret kinds, 0x07 for the dispenser - and no model identity, so it cannot name an entity. actor+0xE8 DOES hold the asset id (verified: 0xED=237 barge turret, 0x14C=332 flag turret), so pairing the two fields across captures names the types directly. Entities were gated on a unit-length basis at +0x8C to reject non-actors.

0x5D.name: barge turret variant - same asset as 0x5C, distinct type
0x5D.confidence: medium - identity of the distinction not established

0xDC.name: SPBargeLever - the Mos lever
0xDC.confidence: high - Mos ONLY, which is correct; Jabba has no levers

0x00.name: Han carbonite objective
0x00.confidence: LOW - type 0x00 may be a default/unset value rather than a real id, though Jabba-only presence is correct since Han exists only there
